integrity: The argument includes an infinite-height depth-pattern lemma. Computations corroborate finite cases but do not substitute for that lemma. Originality limited by indexed and accessible literature.
scientific_limitations: Finite complete rooted regular trees with branching b>=2 and height h>=1; only directed parent-child edge, equality, and ordinary quantifier rank three. No implication for child-indexed successor-function signatures, ancestor order, arbitrary rooted trees, or counting logic.
title: Eight rank-three theories of complete finite branching trees
